set.body: Follow-up after bd-01M272B9FGAY21JTFQ7GEPCY4V. Certificate-aware early stopping now spends the available budget, but a topofmri 8x8 inner cost at epsilon .075, mass .75, tol 1e-10 still has gap 1.223e-6 after 20000 log Dykstra cycles. Other topofmri failures have gaps 6.05e-8 and 7.26e-8. They correctly remain uncertified. Investigate convergence acceleration or a separately certified alternative using an independent constrained dual oracle; preserve capacities, counting-measure entropy and unchanged certificate tolerances. Real-workflow reproduction and input: /Volumes/My Passport for Mac/topofmri/assessment/rfugw-partial-stop-repro.R and rfugw-partial-stop-input.rds. Add representative successful and adversarial comparisons with runtime, iterations, objective gap, feasibility and retained failures. This is remaining numerical performance work, not a claim that the repaired solver returns incorrect certified plans.
set.title: Investigate slow partial Sinkhorn certification near active capacity boundaries
